ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Vector [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Vector[/h1] [i]Crisp, animated vector graphics for ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i]
Adds a [b]vector[/b] element: describe a screen once -- shapes, gradients, text, pictures -- and the game draws it as sharp geometry at any size and animates it on your machine. No per-frame Lua, no per-frame network traffic, and a fraction of the cost of a canvas console.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Rounded panels, paths, liquid tanks, waves, charts and particle fields [*] Linear, radial and conic gradients, real transparency, soft and inner shadows [*] Any number -- and any colour -- can be an expression over time, repeat index or your data, so gauges move smoothly and a button lights under the pointer with nothing sent to the chip [*] Clipping, scrolling lists, clickable nodes, and text in any game font or a Google Font the page asks for [*] Tessellated on a worker thread: an animated console costs well under 1% of a frame [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds nineteen examples that run on paste, a guide (README.md), a full reference (REFERENCE.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector]on GitHub[/url]. With StationeersLua installed, AI editors can read and search the same docs through its MCP server.
[h2]What's new (0.11.94 to 0.11.112)[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Pages bring their own fonts.[/b] A [b]FONT[/b] line names a Google Fonts link, every player's game fetches it (with the ScriptedScreens Fonts mod), and labels switch to it when it arrives -- no re-push [*] [b]Shadows meet borders the way a browser draws them[/b]: inset shadows fade their full depth inside rounded panels, and a border no longer hides its own shadow [*] [b]Thin borders stay crisp[/b] at any size and distance, and shapes stay sharp when you walk right up to a console [*] [b]Mistakes are reported, not silent[/b] -- dozens of quiet failures now show the problem border and a line in vector_stats [*] [b]ver[/b] now reads major*1000000 + minor*1000 + patch, so a newer version always compares higher -- check any script that compares it [*] A new example: fonts from the web [*] Many fixes, including one that could end the game [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector[/url] (MIT).
